description: Implementation of MessageControl class handling message control operations, threading, and messaging client interactions within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: MessageControlImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing message control interface, managing messaging client, threading, and callbacks.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Core::Thread to run dispatch loop in a separate thread.

classes.name: MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class for loading and providing message unit settings.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets or replaces the callback for message collection, manages thread state accordingly.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Adds an instance with specified ID to the messaging client.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Removes an instance with specified ID from the messaging client.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables message categories/modules based on parameters.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves current message control settings as an iterator.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles message updates and invokes callback with message data.
